figurative_meaning_en: To carefully select or distinguish between good and bad; to be picky or choosy
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে খাবার খেতে খুব বাছাবাছি করে।
বাজারে ফল কিনতে গিয়ে অত বাছাবাছি করো না।
example_sentences_in_english: She is very picky about the food she eats.
Don't be so choosy when buying fruits at the market.
note: Often used in contexts implying excessive selectivity, common in Bengali household and market interactions
